signal_to_noise.rationale: Rubric assigns 3 for no tests: there is no noise, but also no signal.

findings.issue: No test infrastructure whatsoever: no test script, no runner (vitest/playwright) in devDependencies, zero test files across 13 source files.
findings.suggestion: Add a lightweight runner (vitest for unit + a few Playwright component/route tests) and a `test` script; start with the pure helpers and loader logic.

findings.issue: Filtering, count and pagination logic (type ∩ generation ∩ search, 48/page slice, page clamp) is completely unguarded.
findings.suggestion: Extract the filter/paginate pipeline into a pure function and unit-test it: empty filter, combined filters, no matches, out-of-range page, boundary pages.

findings.issue: compareRows (missing-values-last in both directions, numeric vs string columns) and aria-sort flip logic have no coverage; a refactor flipping direction handling would put missing values first with no failing test.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test compareRows directly (nulls vs numbers, descending flip) and the methodSortValue ordering table.

findings.issue: refId's URL regex and the id>10000 alternate-form exclusion (cardsFromRefs, ability.tsx:29-33) are the linchpin of 'deoxys-normal shows as Deoxys' and are untested.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test refId against real API URL shapes and cardsFromRefs against refs containing form IDs.

findings.issue: The promise cache's rejection-eviction is correct today but load-bearing for every request; a cached rejected promise would brick all rendering until restart.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test cached(): failure then retry succeeds; concurrent callers share one promise; success stays cached.

findings.issue: URL-state behaviour (debounce, page reset on filter change, default-param omission, back/forward sync of q) is only incidentally covered by acceptance specs.
findings.suggestion: Add a couple of route-level tests asserting the URL after typing/search/select interactions, including page reset.

findings.issue: Pure, cheap-to-test helpers — latestEnglishFlavorText (last en entry, whitespace collapse), dexNumber padding, inMetres/inKilograms, orDash — have no tests.
findings.suggestion: These are five-line unit tests each; do them first.

findings.issue: /types/shadow and /types/unknown render full pages because the loader accepts any type the API has, while the spec's '18 types' definition excludes them — an untested spec edge.
findings.suggestion: Decide the behaviour deliberately (404 or render) and pin it with a test.

findings.issue: Sprite fallback fabricates a URL by pattern (data.server.ts:97) when front_default is null, producing a broken image instead of a graceful placeholder — nothing in-repo catches this against changing API data.
findings.suggestion: Test the card builder with null front_default and render a placeholder or omit the img.

findings.issue: Loaders and components use `any` throughout, so `typecheck` provides near-zero regression protection to complement the missing tests.
findings.suggestion: Use the generated types (Route.LoaderArgs from react-router typegen) so the existing typecheck step has teeth.

summary: The agent wrote no tests of its own — no runner, no script, zero test files — leaving filtering/pagination, move-table sorting, URL state, the caching layer and all pure formatters guarded only by the harness's acceptance suite. The riskiest logic is also untyped (`any` loaders), so refactors of the data layer would currently be verifiable only by hand. Adding a minimal vitest suite for the pure helpers and the sort/filter comparators, plus a few route-level URL-state tests, is the single highest-leverage improvement to this codebase.
